title: Nightreach Observatory - The Haunted Lumenary
_note: Option B mood sibling, more melancholy / Lunar-dark. gbc 4-voice band. town/reverent. Held A minor that never fully resolves, 80 BPM, 4/4, 24 bars. Thinner, more isolated lead — lonelier, sadder, trailing into long rests. Slow minor arp, occasionally a dissonant suspension (B against Am, F against Em) before resolving. Low sparse bass with long silences between roots. Clockwork tick made unsteady — slightly irregular, a clock running down. Vesper motif's settle home DENIED: the rising leap E4->A4->B4 reaches up and resolves to a suspension (B4 over A, the 9th) instead of the tonic, hanging unresolved across the loop seam. Last bar leaves B4/E pickup tension into bar 1.
